name: Dragon Caster (Su)
body:
Spells that normally target specific creature types can also affect dragons as well for you. When a spell says it only affects creatures of a certain type (such as charm person), you can also have it affect dragons as well. You must be at least 5th level to select this arcane discovery.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
